title: A unified Boussinesq--Euler formulation and finite-time blow-up for a Hou--Luo type boundary-jet system
summary: We derive a unified vorticity--stream formulation $(Bm)$ for two parity-reduced inviscid systems in the meridian plane: the 2D inviscid Boussinesq equations $(m=1)$ and the 3D axisymmetric Euler equations with swirl $(m=2)$. In the Boussinesq case we set $Θ=\vartheta/r$ and write $Θ=u^2$ only when a smooth square-root branch has been fixed; equivalently, one may keep the scalar variable $Θ$ throughout.
